title: O(N) acts transitively on subspaces of equal dimension (Step 9(b))
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, E := ℝᴺ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), and let W₀, W ⊆ E be linear subspaces with dim W₀ = dim W. Then there is h ∈ E →L[ℝ] E with h*h = 1 (h* the adjoint) and h(W₀) = W (Submodule.map).
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (W₀ W : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ W₀ = finrank ℝ W → ∃ h : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint h * h = 1 ∧ W₀.map (h : Rn N →ₗ[ℝ] Rn N) = W
